UPDATE This movie has been re-uploaded, you can find it here: The Last Time I Saw Paris

NOTE: Apparently this is another movie that didn't fully upload for some reason.  You may watch the film in it's entirety at www.classiccinemaonline.com by clicking this link: The Last Time I Saw Paris.

My apologies for any inconvenience this may have caused.

Elizabeth Taylor and Van Johnson star in this romantic yet heart wrenching timeline of a troubled marriage.  You can read more about this film on it's IMDB page.
